n: Science Buddies AI and machine learning projects
t: A listing of student AI and machine learning science projects for grades K to 12.
steps: Find the Science Buddies AI and machine learning projects listing.
Pick one project that fits your grade level.
Read its steps and list the materials.
Check which accounts or tools the project needs.
Ask IT to approve any web tool the project uses.
Set a clear question for students to answer.
